invocation_id.description: Unique invocation identifier. Free-form bounded string, no structural semantics.

attempt_id.description: Uniquely identifies this specific attempt within the invocation. Free-form bounded string.

role.description: Role this invocation served. Provider-neutral — no routing policy encoded here. 'challenge' is the conditional independent semantic-challenge model, distinct from 'designer'.

provider.description: Provider identifier (e.g. 'deepseek', 'openai', 'anthropic'). Free-form bounded string — no enum. Provider-neutral by design.

configured_model.description: Model name as configured in the card/routing policy. Free-form bounded string. Model prose/name is NOT authoritative identity — use effective_model for the ground truth.

requested_model.description: Model name as requested to the provider. May differ from effective_model if the provider overrode it. Free-form bounded string.

effective_model.description: The model that actually served the invocation, ONLY when a provider/runtime event independently reports it — never a copy of configured_model/requested_model, which would fabricate a provider attestation that never occurred. Must be exactly the sentinel string 'NOT_REPORTED_BY_PROVIDER' (same convention as provider_request_id) when no such independent report is available for this invocation. Not authoritative identity by default — only a value that differs from configured_model/requested_model and from the sentinel represents an actual provider report.

provider_request_id.description: Provider-side request identifier for traceability. Free-form bounded string.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the invocation started.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the invocation completed.

result_status.description: Outcome of this invocation. Provider-neutral bounded enum.
